messages.subject: Siam Piwat | Global partnerships, sustainability and destination stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Siam Piwat Leadership Team,

Siam Piwat's work across world-class destinations, global brand partnerships and sustainability creates an attractive fit with my experience in institutional relations and stakeholder-led growth.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities include government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and strategic stakeholder engagement.

I lead partnerships and formal engagement across public institutions, communities and business stakeholders in a high-scrutiny investment environment. I also support sustainability and energy-transition initiatives with clear internal governance. That experience would translate well into destination development where growth, reputation and public-private relationships need to move together.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Strategic Partnerships, Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations or executive stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Siam Piwat-focused executive CV and would appreciate your forwarding it to the relevant senior team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
